title: scanf Address Bug
problem: The scanf call is missing the address-of operator for the integer variable. Fix it so the program reads an integer and prints it doubled. For input 5, output should be 10.
starterCode:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){ int n; scanf("%d", n); printf("%d\n", n * 2); return 0; }

title: Uninitialized Variable Sum
problem: The variable `sum` is never initialized before use, causing undefined behavior. Fix it so it correctly prints the sum 1+2+3+4+5 = 15.
starterCode:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){ int sum; for(int i = 1; i <= 5; i++){ sum += i; } printf("%d\n", sum); return 0; }

title: Off-by-One in While Loop
problem: The while loop should print numbers from 1 to 5, but the condition is wrong so it prints 1 to 4 only. Fix the condition.
starterCode:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(){ int i = 1; while(i < 5){ printf("%d\n", i); i++; } return 0; }

title: String Buffer Too Small
problem: The char array is too small to hold the string plus the null terminator, causing overflow. Fix the array size so the program safely prints Hello.
